description:
Tastewise Insights is an agent that helps food and beverage professionals discover trends, consumer needs, and market insights through natural conversation in ChatGPT.

Key Features:
- Ask questions about food trends in natural language
- Get insights on trending ingredients, dishes, and beverages
- Understand consumer motivations and purchasing drivers
- Explore market data across more than 60 countries
- Receive data-driven analysis powered by Tastewise's food intelligence platform
